title: River Review Agent adapter map
description: How each logical Agent (#2014, Epic #2011) is bound on a concrete runtime. This is deliberately a SECOND document: the Agent Contract (`schemas/agent-contract.schema.json`) carries the judgment-relevant declarations (responsibilities, inputs, outputs, skills, authority) and stays runtime-independent, while this document carries only binding mechanics. The split is what makes "a Claude/Codex adapter difference must not leak into a judgment difference" checkable rather than merely asserted: every object here is closed and none of them can hold a judgment field, and `tests/agent-contract.test.mjs` additionally requires that both runtime bindings of an Agent declare the same key set and that every capability a contract requires is provided by every runtime listed here. The runtime capability lists are measurements of the shipped manifests, not aspirations: Claude's from the `tools:` line of `agents/river-review.md`, Codex's from `interface.capabilities` in `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`.

runtimes.description: The runtimes River Review is distributed to. Adding a runtime means adding a key here and a binding for every Agent; a missing binding fails validation instead of silently disabling an Agent.

capability.description: Runtime-neutral capability names, spelled exactly as in `schemas/agent-contract.schema.json`.

capabilitySource.description: The shipped file the capability list was read from, so the list stays a measurement.

binding.description: One runtime's binding for one Agent. `mechanism` records which primitive carries it; `surface` is the shipped path that primitive is declared in; `fallback` records what happens where the runtime lacks the primitive. `skill-only` means the runtime has no agent primitive and the Agent is carried by the shared `skills/agent-skills/` surface, which changes the delivery mechanism and not the judgment. `escalate` hands the judgment to a human. There is no value meaning "run a reduced judgment": a reduced judgment is exactly the leak this document exists to prevent.
